targetType.description: Target type name, if group by "type" was specified.

paused.description: True if the queue is paused, false if it isn't.

initial.description: Number of queue entries in the "initial" status.

pending.description: Number of queue entries in the "pending" status.

disabled.description: Number of queue entries in the "disabled" status.

computingActions.description: Number of actions that are currently computing for the queue entries.

computingEntries.description: Number of queue entries that are currently being computed.

awaitingCompute.description: Number of queue entries that are currently waiting to be computed.

pendingActions.description:
Number of actions required to process all pending entries.  Note this will be computed if the
`includePendingActions` parameter is true in `InvalidationQueue.countAll()` or `InvalidationQueue.count()`.
Otherwise it will be 0.

unreviewedFailed.description: Number of failures that are not yet reviewed.

errorSummary.description:
If an errorSummary was requested in the call to count/countAll, contains the requested
errors for failed entries.

title: Invalidation queue statistics returned by {@link InvalidationQueue.count} and {@link InvalidationQueue.countAll}.
name: InvalidationQueueStats
